INFRARED SAUNA FUSES

Hello! Our main goal is to provide your best quality infrared sauna parts. Just complete the form and our specialist would contact you as soon as possible!

Some reasons to choose us!

  • Maintaining an infrared sauna can be quite a challenge if you can’t find the right supplier to always provide what you.
  • It would be a greater challenge if one day your supplier told you that they couldn’t find the parts that you use at your sauna.
  • Read on to find out more about one supplier that you can count on to be around.

There are many parts and appliances that a sauna owner needs to make sure his/her establishment will be operational. The problem arises when these sauna owners aren’t able to find the right supplier to consistently supply the things they need.

At InfraredSaunaParts, we often get grateful new customers who were referred to us because they have tried to find the parts they need for their sauna from various suppliers. We’ve been in business for more than 15 years and in that span, we’ve supplied various parts and appliances to infrared saunas across the country and also in many other countries.

“I can’t believe how easy it is find something that I need from InfraredSaunaParts. I’ve been in the infrared sauna business for many years and to find one supplier that can supply everything that I need is rare indeed.”

Clara T., Phoenix

Browse through our catalogue to find anything that you need from accessories to electrical parts. All of our parts are certified and safety regulation compliant. For example, our fuses come in different volts and amps so as to suit your sauna needs. We also supply fuse holders and fuse blocks. If you happen to have a unique request, just talk to us about its specification and our team will find it for you.

At InfraredSaunaParts, we have a large facility to store all our goods. And even so, we’re constantly updating our catalogue to make sure we’re able to meet our customers’ needs. No matter when you bought your parts and/or appliances, we’re sure to replace it and supply it for you.

Why not give us a call today and find out more how we can help your business thrive?
